positions.name: Ascent 作者常规架点：原生双人场景 1304

source.coordinate_scope: Exact IEEE-754 float32 values of this case manifest proposal cover/position/retreat/focus; not the tolerance-bounded physical stopping point or grounded query outputs.
source.classification_scope: Explicit project-author conventional/unconventional classification only; no player-frequency or heat-map data.
source.confidence_scope: Manual author trust value 0.8 after repeat static geometry checks; not an 80-percent success rate, player popularity, heat-map frequency or win probability.
source.range_scope: Unknown; scenario names and local distances do not establish near/mid/far labels.

preflight.query_scope: Same-life/source original FindPath plus original ground at cover/open/retreat, three capsule segments cover->open->retreat->cover, closed/open focus rays and four finite static risk rays, under existing shared query budgets.

risk_sample.scope: Four authored static map directions only, from authored open plus original own eye height; not all firing angles or enemy occupancy.
risk_sample.endpoint_rule: Focus endpoint; lateral/rear endpoints at focus height, rotated around open by +/-90/180 degrees, using min(horizontal open-to-focus distance, CoverMaximumAnnotationDistanceCm).
risk_sample.risk_rule: risk = Clear directions / 4; flank_risk = Clear left/right/rear directions / 3; exposed_angles = Clear directions.
risk_sample.default_cap2_scope: Gate comparison only: exposed_angles <= default cap 2 admits this exposure gate for 1501 and rejects 1502. This pair used cap 4; no native default-cap-2 run is claimed.

physical_validation.scope: Two-person forced-class Scenario14 geometry/physical hold test only; firing disabled, other peek/tactics actions disabled, author confidence was 0.5 and exposure cap was 4. No competing-point preference or per-intent native-consumption proof.

source.coverage_limit: This single authored Ascent hold and its measured local query/physical scope only. No all-map coverage, live enemy coordinates, human heat-map, native default-cap-2 run or retained runtime proof. Normal production path/ground/capsule/cover and lifecycle checks remain required.
